title: Under surveillance and being arrested
content: My “mall world” dreams have escalated the past 5 years. The first few years I was alone observing and exploring. I always described it as a “facility” and it seemed to be more run-down and abandoned than a lot of the images I see posted here, but with the same vibe or scenes/locations. I always had a knowing that I am being watched or studied but have no idea by who or what. It always felt like I wasn’t supposed to be there or get caught, but also that whatever was watching me knew I was there and for some reason allowed it. Eventually people began showing up and I was still going unseen…until it seemed they could see me/we could engage. It seemed like the place was up and running again, and that there is an experimental element to it, whatever that means. The latest reoccurring development is that I keep getting arrested. There are sometimes police lingering around me until they actually make the move. I never know why or what I did wrong. They don’t tell me. They’re not necessarily aggressive and I go peacefully. Once I was blindfolded while cuffed and not allowed to see where I was being taken. Once I was tied up with muddy rope instead of cuffs and again, being removed without knowing what I did. Once a police woman seemed to take pity on me or thought I was innocent and tried to help me by giving me a coin (I remember her calling it a veterans coin?) that she claimed was worth something and lead me to believe it would help with my arrest. I’ve also stumbled upon envelopes with my name on them full of surveillance photos of me walking around/exploring this mall world facility. Has anyone experienced something like this in their mall world? What do you think it means? I’m fascinated and it’s always interesting to have these dreams, but it also leaves me feeling a little uneasy…
